critical_code_review_comments: VIPGallery.jsx is clean & well-structured — single source of truth (GALLERY_SETS), small component (140 lines), good lightbox UX, correct lazy-loading, and per-tile data-testid for testability. Nice removal of onError fallback (no longer needed since URLs are stable Unsplash photo IDs).

GALLERY_SETS.motogp and GALLERY_SETS.isle_of_man_tt currently share identical photo IDs and 3 of 4 captions ('Grid walk with the riders' / 'Start line · championship contenders' / 'Raw trackside speed'). This works but if a user visits both an Isle of Man TT page and a MotoGP page in the same session the gallery feels recycled. Low priority — consider sourcing 4 IoM-TT-specific Snaefell/road-racing Unsplash IDs in a future polish pass.

GALLERY_SETS.match and GALLERY_SETS.football are byte-identical (same 4 photo IDs, only captions differ). Could DRY this up by aliasing GALLERY_SETS.football = GALLERY_SETS.match (or sharing via a shared constant) — but visually fine for users.

CheckoutPage.jsx falls back to a synthetic event object when /api/events/{id} 404s (line 33-46). VIPGallery is rendered with eventType={event?.event_type || 'match'} which means for any unknown id the gallery defaults to the 'match' set — this is the correct safe behaviour and was verified.

rca of the issue: Original bug RCA already documented by main agent: (a) old VIPGallery referenced 'f1-paddock' as both index 0 and index 3 → duplicate tile; (b) yellow pixelated FIRE badge in header; (c) WorldCup set used 'Iconic host stadiums' caption with stock images of Wembley/Camp Nou but the captions called them 'MetLife/host stadium' → visual+caption mismatch; (d) UCL Final MongoDB doc had home_team='UCL Finalist 1', away_team='UCL Finalist 2' which the homepage MatchCard rendered as flag placeholders. Fix verified: VIPGallery.jsx now ships 4 distinct Unsplash photo IDs per event_type with contextually correct captions, FIRE badge removed (header uses Sparkles icon in amber gradient circle), HomePage.jsx:136 already gates the flags block on home_team.trim() && away_team.trim(), and the UCL Final document was update_many'd to home_team='' away_team='' so the gate suppresses the flag block.
